cohort: 265 women with one previous transverse CS, singleton cephalic term pregnancy, and Bishop score < 6
finding: Induction of labor with a cervical ripening balloon (CRB) in women with a previous CS and unfavorable Bishop score can be considered safe and effective, with a 57.3% VBAC rate.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with a cervical ripening balloon can be considered safe and effective in women with a previous cesarean section and unfavorable Bishop score.
